orders.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_date, amount
FROM fact_orders
WHERE customer_id = 42
ORDER BY order_id;

t1Orders.sql:
SELECT f.order_id, f.order_date, c.city, f.amount
FROM fact_orders f
JOIN customer_t1 c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id
WHERE f.customer_id = 42
ORDER BY f.order_id;

t1ByCity.sql:
SELECT c.city, SUM(f.amount) AS revenue
FROM fact_orders f
JOIN customer_t1 c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id
WHERE f.customer_id = 42
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY c.city DESC;

t2Rows.sql:

FROM dim_customer
WHERE customer_id = 42
ORDER BY valid_from;

t2Orders.sql:
SELECT f.order_id, f.order_date, d.city, f.amount
FROM fact_orders f
JOIN dim_customer d
  ON  d.customer_id = f.customer_id
  AND f.order_date BETWEEN d.valid_from AND d.valid_to
WHERE f.customer_id = 42
ORDER BY f.order_id;

t2ByCity.sql:
SELECT d.city, SUM(f.amount) AS revenue
FROM fact_orders f
JOIN dim_customer d
  ON  d.customer_id = f.customer_id
  AND f.order_date BETWEEN d.valid_from AND d.valid_to
WHERE f.customer_id = 42
GROUP BY d.city
ORDER BY d.city DESC;

t6Fill.sql:

SET current_city = c.city
FROM dim_customer c
WHERE c.customer_id = d.customer_id
  AND c.is_current;

SELECT o.order_id, d.customer_key, o.amount
FROM staged_orders o
JOIN dim_customer d
  ON d.customer_id = o.customer_id;

snap.setup:
CREATE TABLE order_events (order_id INTEGER, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP);
INSERT INTO order_events VALUES
  (501, 'placed',    TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01 09:00'),
  (501, 'paid',      TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01 09:05'),
  (502, 'placed',    TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01 10:00'),
  (502, 'paid',      TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01 10:02'),
  (502, 'cancelled', TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01 16:30'),
  (501, 'shipped',   TIMESTAMP '2024-06-02 14:00');

snapshot.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_snapshot AS
SELECT order_id, status
FROM order_events
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY changed_at DESC) = 1;

snapshotRows.sql: SELECT order_id, status FROM order_snapshot ORDER BY order_id;

paidThenCancelled.sql:
SELECT order_id
FROM order_events
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING bool_or(status = 'paid')
   AND bool_or(status = 'cancelled');

counts.sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_events) AS log_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_snapshot) AS snapshot_rows;

orders.sql: SELECT order_key, amount FROM fact_orders ORDER BY order_key;

rows.sql: SELECT order_key, promo_key, weight FROM order_promotion_bridge ORDER BY order_key, promo_key;

total.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM fact_orders;

fanout.sql:
SELECT p.promo_name, SUM(f.amount) AS revenue
FROM fact_orders f
JOIN order_promotion_bridge b ON b.order_key = f.order_key
JOIN dim_promotion p          ON p.promo_key  = b.promo_key
GROUP BY p.promo_name
ORDER BY p.promo_name DESC;

weighted.sql:
SELECT p.promo_name,
       SUM(f.amount * b.weight) AS attributed_revenue
FROM fact_orders f
JOIN order_promotion_bridge b ON b.order_key = f.order_key
JOIN dim_promotion p          ON p.promo_key  = b.promo_key
GROUP BY p.promo_name
ORDER BY p.promo_name DESC;

weightSums.sql:
SELECT order_key, SUM(weight) AS weights
FROM order_promotion_bridge
GROUP BY order_key
ORDER BY order_key;

usedBy.sql:
SELECT p.promo_name, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM order_promotion_bridge b
JOIN dim_promotion p ON p.promo_key = b.promo_key
GROUP BY p.promo_name
ORDER BY p.promo_name DESC;

lines.sql: SELECT order_number, product, amount FROM fact_order_lines;

degenerate.sql:
SELECT order_number, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM fact_order_lines
GROUP BY order_number
ORDER BY order_number;

junk.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS junk_rows
FROM (VALUES ('card'), ('cash'), ('voucher')) p(payment),
     (VALUES (true), (false)) g(is_gift),
     (VALUES ('web'), ('store')) c(channel);

shipments.sql: SELECT order_id, order_date_key, ship_date_key FROM fact_shipments;

dates.sql: SELECT date_key, full_date, day_name FROM dim_date ORDER BY date_key;

role.sql:
SELECT f.order_id,
       od.day_name AS ordered,
       sd.day_name AS shipped
FROM fact_shipments f
JOIN dim_date od ON od.date_key = f.order_date_key
JOIN dim_date sd ON sd.date_key = f.ship_date_key;
